jobs.description:
You will be responsible for:
 

 
• Moving and dragging foam blocks
 
• Manually feeding the machine
 
• Picking up foam scraps from the floor
 
• Keeping the workplace clean and organized
 
• Working together with your colleague to ensure a smooth production process 

 
• You speak Dutch or English.
 
• You are physically strong and enjoy active work.
 
• You can perform repetitive tasks accurately.
 
• You enjoy working together with a colleague.
 
• Experience is not required; motivation is more important.
 
• You can work in a day shift, and when production volumes increase, you are willing to work in a 2-shift system.

Opportunity

€63,000–€95,000 gross/year · Hybrid (2 days on-site per week, at client premises or company office; 3 days from home) · Permanent, full-timeThe systems that track assets, flag maintenance needs and inform mission readiness do not run on gut feeling, they run on clean data and sharp analysis. As Analytics Engineer you will split your time between being embedded at a defence customer site as part of a structured Forward Deployed Engineer team and contributing to the Product Engineering Team, turning raw operational data into the dashboards and insights that operational teams actually rely on. The rotation structure means you carry real on-site ownership while a full team provides backup and coverage; you are not alone.

Your Mission

• Own the SQL layer end-to-end, from raw source data through to production-ready models, with performance and maintainability as the standard.
• Build and maintain analytical and dimensional models that underpin asset tracking, maintenance workflows, readiness reporting and mission planning, datasets that operational teams act on, not prototypes.
• Author and publish dashboards and views in close cooperation with client stakeholders, translating operational requirements into analytical deliverables that are clear, accurate and fit for a defence environment.
• Apply Python for data transformation, lightweight analysis and integration glue work, keeping pipelines reliable and documented.
• Elicit and interpret requirements directly from French- and Dutch-speaking client teams when forward deployed, then translate those needs into concrete analytical outputs.
• Own testing and technical documentation during on-site rotations, with clean handover to the wider engineering, testing and documentation teams between deployments.
What success looks like

Over time, the client teams you support will reach for your dashboards first because the data behind them is trustworthy and the models are built to last. Requirements you gather on-site translate cleanly into working deliverables. Domain experts recognise that you understood what they needed — not just what they said. The components you build are documented well enough that the wider team can maintain, extend and take them into operational use without relying on your recall.

What you bring

• Production-grade SQL, complex transformations, modelling and query optimisation, not basic retrieval.
• Practical Python scripting for ETL, data transformation, analysis and automation; this is not a software engineering role, but the code you write must be clean and maintainable.
• Analytical and dimensional modelling at mid-to-senior level — this is the core technical differentiator for the role.
• Dashboard authoring experience in at least one BI or analytical tool; you will work with proprietary tooling here and ramp up on it after joining, so transferable experience is what counts.
• Consulting and requirements-gathering skills, when forward deployed you are the primary client interface, and the ability to elicit, interpret and translate operational requirements is essential.
• Professional working proficiency in French, Dutch and English — you will conduct requirements discussions in both French and Dutch and coordinate in English; all three are required for delivery and this is not flexible.
• Git discipline and comfort working in structured, security-conscious environments with the composure that client-facing work in defence demands.
• Eligibility to obtain and maintain the required national or NATO security clearance for this role (we support candidates through the clearance process).
The language requirement and clearance eligibility are firm; for everything else, we consider the overall strength of your experience.

Nice to have

• Experience working with logistics, maintenance, asset-management or defence-operations data.
• Prior experience with Oracle or PostgreSQL in a data modelling or transformation context

Are you a financial expert and does accounting have no secrets for you? Do you like studying figures and do you like to have ownership? Then the position of Senior Accountant at Miele Belux is your next career step! In this position, you are the pivot between the financial processes, the people and the resulting administration. Together with the controllers, shared service centre and external parties, such as our accountants and advisors, you ensure accurate accounting. This not only involves the correct administration of the figures, but also identifying bottlenecks and risks in terms of legislation and regulations. You will be working in a multinational team, with a manager who focuses on your talents and prepares you for a great career within Miele. The many international contacts within the Miele group offer you the opportunity to build an interesting network.
 

What you will be doing:
 

The Senior Accountant plays a vital role in maintaining the financial integrity of the organization by ensuring accurate financial record-keeping, timely processing of transactions, and compliance with group financial policies and local regulatory requirements. The role supports effective financial management through attention to detail, strong analytical skills, and a commitment to excellence. You are the first point of contact within the Belgium affiliate and the right hand of the Accounting Manager covering the cluster of Belgium/Luxembourg/Netherlands/France.
 

Key Responsibilities:
 
 

• Support month-end and year-end closing activities for the Belgian entity in collaboration with our global shared services (MGS) teams in Poland. 

• Ensure accurate bookings, accruals, reconciliations, and allocations to cost and profit centers. 

• Be a key point of contact for external and internal audit matters. 

• Support tax and legal compliance processes, including VAT, and other statutory declarations. 

• Evaluate internal systems, controls, and risks, and provide recommendations for improvement. 

• Contribute to Belgian and global process optimization projects. 

• Support the FP&A team with financial transparency, reporting, and follow-up.  

 

The Senior Account we are looking for:
 

We are looking for someone who is structured, accountable, and principled, with a strong sense of ownership for financial integrity and operational follow-through. You enjoy working with both numbers and practical coordination, and you are comfortable communicating with internal stakeholders as well as external service partners.
 
 

• Bachelor’s degree in finance or accounting, economics or business administration. 

• +8 years of experience in a similar role. 

• A strong accounting foundation, with proven experience in closing periods, balance sheet ownership, statutory and tax reporting. 

• Handles sensitive financial information with the highest level of confidentiality, integrity, and accountability while adhering to professional and organizational standards. 

• Communicates financial information clearly and professionally to colleagues, management, auditors, and other stakeholders. 

• A proactive, detail-oriented approach with a passion for continuous improvement and eagerness to take ownership, contribute to harmonization of processes across the region. 

• Works collaboratively across departments and builds positive relationships. 

• Able to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines. 

• Experience in a multinational, multi-location matrix environment.. 

• Experience working with SAP is an advantage, proficiency in Excel. 

• Excellent communication skills in English and Dutch/French, both written and verbal.

For our client in Beernem, we are looking for an experienced tiler.
 

You will join a young and dynamic team.
 

Be sure to apply if you are interested!
 

 
 

 

 
 

 
• You are a worker with several years of experience in tiling
 
• A driving licence is required!
 
• You speak fluent Dutch or English
 
• You have a VCA certificate or are willing to obtain one

Opportunity

Hybrid (2 days on-site per week) · Permanent, full-time

About the role

You'll keep one or more defence software Squads moving, running ceremonies, clearing blockers, and turning Agile principles into daily practice, with senior Scrum Masters and Agile Coaches alongside you as you find your footing. This is a permanent role in a Spotify-inspired organisation (Squads, Chapters, Tribes), and the mentoring structure is a deliberate design feature, not a vague promise.

Your Mission

What you'll do

• Facilitate Scrum ceremonies, Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Reviews, Retrospectives and Backlog Refinement, so your Squad leaves each session with clarity and a workable plan.
• Identify and remove impediments that slow delivery, escalating where needed and working with stakeholders to keep momentum.
• Partner with Market Product Managers on backlog refinement, sprint readiness and prioritisation so the Squad is always working on the right things.
• Collaborate with Tech Writers to make sure documentation is planned and aligned with sprint goals, not bolted on afterwards.
• Monitor team health and track Agile metrics, using what you learn to support continuous improvement in ways of working.
• Coordinate with other Scrum Masters, Chapters and stakeholders to surface and manage cross-Squad dependencies before they become blockers.
What success looks like

Over time, your Squads run ceremonies that feel purposeful rather than routine: the team arrives prepared, leaves aligned, and the retrospective actually changes something. Impediments get named early and resolved rather than accumulating. You start spotting dependency risks before they surface as problems, and your collaboration with Market Product Managers and Tech Writers becomes a natural part of the Squad rhythm rather than a coordination overhead.

 

What you bring

• Up to two years of experience in an Agile environment, as a Scrum Master, Project Coordinator, Business Analyst, QA or a comparable role where you worked alongside or within Agile ceremonies.
• Working knowledge of Scrum and Agile principles, conceptual fluency you can apply in a real Squad, not necessarily a certification.
• Facilitation and communication skills strong enough to keep a room moving and surface issues without creating friction.
• Organisational discipline to track dependencies and keep multiple moving parts visible.
• Ability to build working relationships across multidisciplinary teams, including people in technical, product and writing roles.
• Professional working proficiency in English.
• Eligibility to obtain and maintain the required national or NATO security clearance for this role. ILIAS Solutions supports candidates through the clearance process and is glad to explain what is involved before you apply.
If you meet most of the above, we encourage you to apply. The eligibility requirement for the required security authorisation is not flexible.

Nice to have

• PSM I or CSM certification, if you already hold one, great; if not, that is fine.
• Hands-on experience in a Spotify-inspired organisation with Squads, Chapters and Tribes.
• Exposure to Agile metrics and structured retrospective or improvement practices.
• Familiarity with tools like Jira or comparable Agile board software.

jobs.description:
Opportunity

Ensure the quality and reliability of our Defense Platform which offers a complete in-service support lifecycle for materials, consumables, and repairable items within defense organizations.You focus on validating Enterprise Suite functionalities, testing APIs, and ensuring that systems behave as expected in environments where quality and reliability matter.Meaningful Work in a Mission Driven EnvironmentYour work supports applications used in operational environments. You ensure that functionality, integrations, and business processes are reliable, consistent, and ready to support users and operational activities.The Impact You Help CreateYou improve application quality, reduce risk, and ensure that business-critical systems perform reliably. Your work supports consistent and trustworthy outcomes.

Your Mission

What you will do:

• Design, execute, and maintain detailed test plans and test cases covering functional and non-functional testing
• Perform API testing
• Perform integration, regression, and end-to-end testing activities
• Identify, document, and track defects
• Support test documentation and reporting
• Work with development teams to resolve issues and improve quality
• Contribute to structured testing processes and continuous improvement
• Support automated testing activities

What You Bring

• Experience in manual and functional testing
• Strong experience with API testing
• Proven experience using Postman
• Understanding of testing methodologies (ISTQB foundation level or similar knowledge)
• Experience with test and defect management tools such as Jira, Spira, Xray, or similar
• Knowledge of test automation tools such as Playwright or equivalent
• Analytical mindset and attention to detail
• Strong communication skills in English
• Ability to work independently and within a team
Systems Thinking and Analytical StrengthYou understand how business processes, application functionality, APIs, and system behavior connect. You analyze outcomes and ensure that applications perform consistently across scenarios.Working Across Teams and FunctionsYou work with developers, analysts, and others stakeholders. You support collaboration and ensure that quality is maintained across the development process.

Opportunity

This is an office-based role. Candidates are expected to work from our office at least 4 days per week. Remote work is limited to 1 day per week.

Building reliable infrastructure from the inside

Reliable infrastructure is about more than keeping systems running. It means understanding how an environment works, solving problems at their source and creating systems that become easier to manage over time.As a System Engineer at ILIAS Solutions, you take ownership of the infrastructure behind our international organization. This is an internal IT position: you will not work directly with customers, but you will support the people who build, deliver, implement and support the ILIAS Defense Platform.You work across Linux systems, hybrid infrastructure and automation. Alongside day-to-day operations, you look for patterns: where recurring work can be automated, where configurations can become more consistent and where better documentation can make the environment easier to understand. The goal is clear: continue moving infrastructure from reactive support towards a structured, automated and predictable engineering environment.

Meaningful work

ILIAS develops software for demanding defense and security environments, and the people behind that work depend on reliable technology every day. As part of Internal IT, your impact is internal but reaches across the organization: you help create the technical foundation that enables development teams to build, implementation teams to deliver and support teams to help customers. When infrastructure is stable, secure and well managed, colleagues across Belgium, the Netherlands, Denmark and the United States can work with fewer disruptions and greater confidence.

Your Mission

What will you do?

• Manage and improve the internal server infrastructure that supports ILIAS employees across offices, teams and business functions.
• Take ownership of Linux system administration, including installation, configuration, maintenance, troubleshooting, patching and performance follow-up.
• Use Ansible to automate recurring work, standardize configurations and make infrastructure changes repeatable, traceable and less dependent on manual execution.
• Maintain Linux and Windows Server environments across VMware, Azure and on-premises infrastructure.
• Investigate complex infrastructure, system, software and network issues with an analytical mindset and a focus on sustainable solutions, not quick fixes only.
• Contribute to clear documentation, monitoring, backup routines, operational procedures and continuous improvement of internal IT processes.
• Support secure and reliable access to the internal systems and infrastructure services used by ILIAS colleagues every day.
• Work with the reliability, quality and security awareness expected from a company active in the defence domain and certified according to ISO 9001 and Cyber Essentials.
 

What you bring?

• Proven experience as a Linux System Administrator or System Engineer.
• Strong hands-on expertise in Linux server environments. Linux is not a side topic in this role; it is one of the core areas where we need depth.
• Solid experience with Ansible, including playbooks, automation and configuration management.
• Good knowledge of Azure and experience with cloud or hybrid infrastructure environments.
• Knowledge of VMware and Windows Server environments.
• A security-minded approach to infrastructure and operations.
• Strong analytical thinking skills: you can investigate issues thoroughly, identify root causes and explain your reasoning clearly.
• A predictable and transparent way of working: you document what you do, communicate clearly and keep colleagues informed before, during and after changes.
• The maturity to take ownership, challenge unclear requests, ask the right questions and work towards sustainable improvements.
• A degree in IT, Computer Science or equivalent experience.
• At least C1 level in Dutch and English.

Opportunity
Ensure the quality and reliability of our PLUS Platform .PLUS exists so ILIAS can focus on its core business. We take on the opportunities, challenges, and initiatives that require new thinking, new technology, or a different approach. By carrying part of the innovation, transformation, and operational load, we help the organisation move faster and prepare for what comes next. Adaptability is our superpower. We don't just respond to change, we work where ILIAS will be tomorrow.You focus on validating PLUS functionalities and ensuring that systems behave as expected in environments where quality and reliability matter.Meaningful Work in a Mission Driven EnvironmentYour work supports applications used in operational environments. You ensure that functionality, integrations, and business processes are reliable, consistent, and ready to support users and operational activities.The Impact You Help CreateYou improve application quality, reduce risk, and ensure that business-critical systems perform reliably. Your work supports consistent and trustworthy outcomes.

Are you passionate about delivering an outstanding employee technology experience? Do you enjoy acting as the bridge between business needs and IT services? Are you looking for a role where you can shape and improve the modern workplace within a growing international organization?

As Workplace Lead, you will own and continuously enhance the digital workplace environment, ensuring employees have the tools, support, and technology they need to perform at their best.You will act as the key point of contact for workplace services, driving service excellence, managing vendors, and supporting digital transformation initiatives across the business.Key Responsibilities

• Define and execute the Digital Workplace roadmap in line with business objectives.
• Ensure the reliability, performance, and continuous improvement of workplace technologies and collaboration tools.
• Manage end-user computing services, collaboration platforms, devices, and workplace-related infrastructure.
• Oversee external IT service providers and ensure agreed service levels are met.
• Monitor user satisfaction, identify areas for improvement, and implement best practices to enhance the employee experience.
• Lead workplace-related projects, including technology rollouts, migrations, and process improvements.
• Collaborate closely with business stakeholders to understand operational needs and translate them into effective technology solutions.
• Support IT governance, cybersecurity, and compliance initiatives related to workplace services.
• Manage budgets and contracts within the workplace domain.
• Contribute to shaping a modern, efficient, and user-centric technology environment.
 

Profile

• Several years of experience in Digital Workplace, End-User Services, IT Operations, or Workplace Management.
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365, collaboration platforms, device management, and modern workplace technologies.
• Experience managing third-party vendors and service providers.
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
• Strong customer-service mindset with a focus on delivering high-quality user experiences.
• Ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced, international environment.
• Fluent in English; additional European languages are considered a plus.

You will 
support the 
implementation of the Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR) within our European logistics network. By 
working closely with suppliers and internal stakeholders, you will ensure that packaging processes comply with 
legal requirements and meet established project objectives. 

 
• Track and monitor suppliers’ compliance with the Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR) to ensure project deadlines are met on time. 
 
• Organize and facilitate online meetings with suppliers. 
 
• Discussing and clarifying different types of packaging and the roles and responsibilities of suppliers. 
 
• Explaining the PPWR requirements and expectations regarding compliance. 
 
• Coordinating implementation plans and setting target dates for execution. 
 
• Closely monitoring suppliers’ corrective actions and implementation plans, including tracking progress, milestones, and deadlines. 
 
• Preparing weekly reports for management on suppliers’ compliance status. 
 
• Identifying risks, areas of concern, and escalations that require further management support. 
 
• Conducting compliance audits and checks on manufacturer labels within warehouse operations. 
 
• Verifying that packaging and labeling processes comply with applicable PPWR guidelines and internal quality standards. 
 
• Actively contributing to a compliant, efficient, and sustainable supply chain within the logistics operation.  

Education and Relevant Experience:  

 
• You hold a bachelor’s degree in a technical, logistics, or business-related field. 
 
• Experience with sustainable packaging solutions is a plus.  
 
Competencies & Skills:  

 
• You communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing. 
 
• You have strong communication skills and know how to interact professionally with various stakeholders. 
 
• You have a good knowledge of Excel and are proficient in using SharePoint. Knowledge of Access and Power BI for data analysis and tracking is a plus. 
 
• You are able to manage multiple vendors, tasks, and deadlines simultaneously. 
 
• You work in a structured manner and have strong organizational and prioritization skills. 
 
• You are meticulous, reliable, and able to work independently. 
 
• You take initiative and proactively follow up on tasks to achieve set objectives. 
 
• You are motivated to further develop yourself and are determined to achieve challenging goals. 
 
• You base your recommendations and decisions on facts and feedback. 
 
• You have strong planning and organizational skills. 
 
• You enjoy working as part of a team, show respect for others, and believe in people’s growth. 
 
• You combine a positive attitude and a sense of humor with a strong work ethic. 
 
• You constantly contribute ideas for improvements and actively seek ways to optimize processes.

Primary Responsibilities

 
• Design, develop, and refine yeast extract-driven solutions for a variety of savory food applications, including soups, stocks, sauces, and snack flavoring systems.
 
• Drive recipe creation and continuous optimization to improve flavor intensity, enhance umami profiles, and achieve balanced taste performance.
 
• Perform sensory assessments and analyze evaluation results to support product development and strategic market positioning.
 
• Convert customer requirements and market insights into effective, scalable, and commercially viable formulations.
 
• Investigate ingredient functionality within complex food systems and resolve technical formulation issues.
 
• Carry out market intelligence activities, including competitive product reviews and emerging trend monitoring in savory applications.
 
• Provide technical support for customer projects through prototype development, problem resolution, and product demonstrations.
 
• Work closely with commercial, marketing, and international R&D teams to accelerate innovation initiatives and business growth.
 
• Maintain adherence to regulatory requirements, quality standards, and internal product development procedures.

Profile & Expertise

 
• Master's degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Food Engineering, or a related scientific discipline.
 
• Demonstrated expertise in product formulation and application development within one or more savory segments such as soups, seasonings, sauces, or bouillons.
 
• Outstanding junior professionals with strong academic achievements, internships, or relevant project experience are welcome to apply.
 
• Solid knowledge of sensory science, flavor characterization, and sensory-driven product development.
 
• Strong understanding of ingredient performance, flavor synergy, and behavior within food systems.
 
• Capable of planning and executing experiments independently while drawing meaningful conclusions from technical data.
 
• Excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills with a focus on formulation improvement and optimization.
 
• Effective communication skills and the ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and external clients.
 
• Commercial awareness with the ability to connect technical solutions to customer and business needs.
 
• Fluent English communication skills, both written and verbal.
 
• Availability for occasional travel across Europe for customer meetings, industry exhibitions, and knowledge-sharing sessions at the company's headquarters in China.

Core Responsibilities

 
• Develop, refine, and enhance bakery solutions utilizing yeast-based ingredients, including baker's yeast, yeast extracts, yeast proteins, and other specialty baking components.
 
• Plan and conduct practical baking trials tailored to customer needs while aligning with current European bakery market demands and consumer trends.
 
• Lead recipe formulation and continuous product optimization for breads, viennoiseries, laminated pastries, and a wide range of fermented baked goods.
 
• Deliver technical expertise and customized product solutions to strategic customers and bakery manufacturers throughout Europe.
 
• Organize and perform bakery demonstrations in customer facilities, application centers, and industry exhibitions, both for individual clients and larger groups.
 
• Translate customer specifications and commercial opportunities into scalable formulations and effective technical recommendations.
 
• Partner closely with commercial, marketing, and global R&D teams to support innovation initiatives and business growth objectives.
 
• Monitor industry developments, competitor offerings, ingredient innovations, and advances in bakery processing technologies.
 
• Ensure all development activities comply with applicable regulations, quality requirements, and internal research and development procedures.

Qualifications & Professional Skills

 
• Degree in Food Science, Food Technology, Baking Technology, Milling Technology, or a related field. Practical bakery training or hands-on experience as a baker is highly valued.
 
• Minimum of 5 years' experience in bakery product development, ideally within premix manufacturers, industrial bakeries, or yeast ingredient companies.
 
• Strong expertise in bakery ingredient functionality, dough behavior, flour performance evaluation, and process optimization.
 
• Proven ability to design trials, analyze technical results, identify root causes, and resolve formulation challenges.
 
• Hands-on and solution-oriented professional capable of working autonomously in a laboratory and application environment.
 
• Commercial awareness with the ability to transform technical expertise into tangible customer benefits.
 
• Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills, with experience working across departments and directly with customers.
 
• Excellent presentation and communication abilities, including delivering technical training sessions, demonstrations, and customer workshops.
 
• Fluent in English, both written and spoken, for international collaboration; knowledge of French or Dutch is considered an asset.
 
• Flexible and willing to travel across Europe for customer meetings, trade fairs, and knowledge-sharing visits to the company's headquarters in China.

Key Responsibilities

 
• Design, develop, and enhance yeast-protein-based solutions for a range of food applications, including sports nutrition products, plant-based dairy substitutes, and baked goods.
 
• Drive recipe development and continuous prototype improvement to achieve targeted functionality, such as texture enhancement, emulsification, gel formation, and overall product performance.
 
• Analyze sensory evaluation results and transform insights into actionable recommendations for formulation refinement and product advancement.
 
• Perform competitive product assessments and monitor industry developments related to proteins and functional ingredients.
 
• Convert customer requirements and market expectations into effective technical concepts and scalable product solutions.
 
• Provide technical expertise for customer-focused projects, including prototype preparation, issue resolution, and technical demonstrations.
 
• Partner with commercial, marketing, and international R&D teams to deliver innovative products aligned with business objectives.
 
• Maintain adherence to regulatory guidelines, quality requirements, and internal research and development procedures.

Qualifications & Skills

 
• Master's degree in Food Science, Food Technology, Food Engineering, or a closely related field.
 
• Demonstrated background in product formulation and application development within food systems such as sports nutrition, plant-based alternatives, bakery products, or similar sectors. Talented early-career candidates with relevant academic projects or internship exposure are welcome to apply.
 
• Strong expertise in sensory assessment, product characterization, and structured evaluation methodologies.
 
• In-depth knowledge of ingredient performance, protein functionality, and interactions within complex food matrices.
 
• Ability to independently plan trials, execute experiments, and draw meaningful conclusions from technical findings.
 
• Excellent analytical and troubleshooting abilities related to formulation challenges and product improvement.
 
• Effective interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across departments and engage with customers.
 
• Commercial awareness and the capability to translate technical innovations into business and customer benefits.
 
• Fluent English communication skills, both verbal and written, for international collaboration.
 
• Flexibility to travel for customer meetings, industry exhibitions throughout Europe, and knowledge-sharing activities with the headquarters in China.
